results.title: Research Radio
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto is the curator and creator of the 'Research Radio' podcast, which features AI-generated deep dives and discussions on computational social science research. The scripts are co-developed with Anthropic's Claude and narrated by Google Gemini, with regular weekly episodes published throughout July and August 2026.

results.title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto was featured as a speaker and panelist at the International Conference on Social Media and Society (#SMSociety 2026) held in Glasgow, UK, from July 13–15, 2026. He participated in the 'Meta Content Library Community Roundtable: Where to for Social Media Research?' panel to discuss researcher access to social media platform data.
